description.value: Yianni's Greek Taverna is a family-owned restaurant that has anchored Uptown New Westminster since 2000, earning multiple Best Greek Restaurant awards in the city. The blue-and-white interior seats diners alongside a patio, and the menu spans classic Greek dips, grilled meats, lamb dishes, and imported Greek wines and beer. It caters to families and corporate groups alike and also offers community catering.
